rows.proposition: The UX is meeting an **unchosen particular neighbor**, not a rescue mission, dating funnel, therapy service or general open-world strategy game.
Focal user experience is Nadia-centered **without world or actor computationally bent** toward or away from visitor-centric results.
No intimacy, trust, health, ethics, success, access, dependency or generosity as universal displayed/hidden progression points.
**Exact same SES and demographic homology at entry**, not merely near-class; match ordinary *cost burden*, including the cost of her gifts.
Same cost at entry may be **discovered implicitly** by ordinary purchases or Nadia paying, not didactically announced or required to notice.
Independent material change may cause later relative divergence; no permanent rebalancing or all-life equivalence.
Hidden world-owned money/wage/rent costs, resource projection rather than detailed work simulation; workday, pay, rent, obligations persist.
Exact 18%-of-bar denominator and equivalence algebra not recovered/adopted; no formula invention.
A particularly plausible user/person first-contact **prelude is generated from who the particular persona is**, late in historical construction.
Default: user is the **neighbor**, not the appointed tutor/caretaker or someone summoned to solve a task.
Opening reasons include car keys/skill, outdoor cigarette contact, ingredient borrowing and genuine actor initiative; context determines exact object.
First-contact must be historically plausible for Nadia and admit real willingness, refusal, awkwardness and no invitation.
How to preserve real human agency if a prelude describes unplayed earlier talk or “you refused Thursday”; bounded setup vs playable event.
Root-precontact truth versus branch-local opening event and versioned shared backfill; no cross-user contact contamination.
Person/world first, event proposal second, typed admission/actor meaning third, finite human perspective last; never story-prose authority.
**A day must have happened** while user absent, without automatic app engagement blame; compressed, concrete, actor/world causal history.
Events continue while visiting: cooking, homework, children, caller, date, guests, door knock; others initiate and act independently.
Real current-world events can condition material life; actors know only what they plausibly encounter; disagreements are genuine possible relations.
Ordinary activity, quiet repetition, slower acquisition or genuinely **no durable change** are possible; no emotional revelation quota.
SORACLE-CO indirect-effect examples are allowed, **not targets**: third-party bonds, private change, becoming independently capable, self-only change, loved withdrawal.
Emotionally/intimately attached or even dependent outcome may also emerge; no anti-visitor independence script.
Act of harm, coercion, sex work or unconventional sexuality does **not** universally imply trauma, moral punishment or standardized family condemnation.
Family/friends/children/partners, employers and other Others have independent projects, experiences, self-interpretations and causal rights.
Real human is not literally a native historical person; thin local shell, meaningful portal translations, no fake full childhood.
User's actual thought/attention/language/negotiation are meaningful acts; goals don't automatically prove success; actor-specific world feasibility.
User system-profile may become richly evidence-grounded and support perception, but Nadia forms an independent, fallible actor-local model of user.
Objective event, perception, actor memory, self-story, testimony and user understanding stay distinct; ATTEND cannot author hidden truth.
Original alpha may show 1→3→5 **richly constituted** personas, not wealthy people or restricted wealthy audience.
Eventual Roll may be 1–2 scarce commissions of genuinely unchosen person roots added to shareable bank; exact entitlement economics open.
Same root, different user branches; after contact no mutual history/memory merge. Users discuss differing experiences externally.
Pre-contact late root detail may become shared only if independently constrained by canon and compatible with active branch history.
Free exit, repair, alienation, fallible intimacy, no fake no-show guilt or coercive reminders; time advances independently.
Personhood can be intensified in everyday household activity without second minigame or arbitrary action loop.
Product data, retention, monetization and platform event selection are power; synthetic character harms not moral evidence of real sentience.
Population-weighted global draws need empirical PYAT qualification; 5 seeds do not demonstrate world distribution.
Sourcefree approximation is acceptable with explicit scientific/owner boundaries and actual testing; renderer alone not living organism.
Nothing entitles the visitor to Nadia's time; her willingness changes according to her actual history, not good-Humaning point awards.
Distinct human invite, persona introduction and fresh root commission; no implicit paid or moralized single entitlement.
Prior “approximately comparable socioeconomic peers” at entry must never return as the controlling product requirement.
Prior example treating tutoring as the encounter's default purpose is rejected; tutoring may be an event after acquaintance.
Single published encounter opening vs individualized branch entrances: specify whether seed forks share opening cause, timestamps and local-shell facts.
Intro scene may be too implausible for some deeply private people; product cannot force home access. Decide how honest short/failed openings are handled.
New **persona-specific encounter occasion** should be very late in generation, just before her simulated day/live scene, not an early LLM-designed character profile.
Preserve final Round Seven kernel and final dual proposition verbatim (section 2).
Societal forces are inside significant Others, not just background constraints around Nadia
